The '''Roamer-6''' was a [[Breath mask/Legends|breath mask]] produced by [[Gandorthral Atmospherics/Legends|Gandorthral Atmospherics]].

==Description==
[[File:HanRoamer6-TESB.png|thumb|left|180px|[[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] wearing a Roamer-6.]]
The Roamer-6 was a type of [[Breath mask/Legends|breath mask]] manufactured by [[Gandorthral Atmospherics/Legends|Gandorthral Atmospherics]]. The mask fit over the nose and mouth of the wearer, held in place by an adjustable strap that fit around the back of the head.<ref name="EGWT" /> A basic mask, it was compact and easy to wear, even while the wearer was engaged in rigorous activities. The mask itself could be worn by a number of [[Species/Legends|species]], including [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]].<ref name="NEGWT">''[[The New Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref>

An air hose connected the mask to a purifier that could be clipped to the wearer's [[Clothing/Legends|clothing]], or tucked into a pocket. The purifier's [[Computer/Legends|computer]] could be programmed to handle the environmental needs of a number of species, and could be adjusted manually while in use. Each mask had a small [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]] integrated into it, and [[molecular hook]]s allowed the mask to be clipped to [[Goggles/Legends|goggles]] or [[Blast helmet/Legends|blast helmet]].<ref name="EGWT" />

The Roamer-6 was designed to operate in a variety of [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmospheres]], allowing the wearer to survive in environments from near-[[Vacuum/Legends|vacuum]] to [[Poison/Legends|poisoned]] air. Six layers of [[atmospheric scrubber]]s were used to filter out dangerous [[Gas/Legends|gases]], dust particles, pollen, microscopic contaminants,<ref name="EGWT" /> [[Bacteria/Legends|bacteria]], and viral organisms.<ref name="NEGWT" /> The scrubbers were also capable of breaking down compound gases for use in the absence of breathable air; [[Carbon dioxide/Legends|carbon dioxide]] could be converted into breathable [[Oxygen/Legends|oxygen]]. The filters had an [[Standard hour/Legends|hour]] of use, and replacements could be easily fitted while in the field. The gas filter also had a connected compressed gas tank that carried a ten-[[Standard minute/Legends|minute]] air supply.<ref name="EGWT" />

The [[intake]] on the Roamer-6 was able to compress thin atmospheres and dilute thick atmospheres. A temperature adjuster allowed the wearer to heat or chill the air being breathed to a comfortable level,<ref name="EGWT" /> preventing damage to the throat of [[Lung/Legends|lungs]].<ref name="NEGWT" /> The gas filter could be fitted to a larger [[air tank]] via a tank coupler on the bottom of the unit. These tanks were typically worn on the back. It could also be fitted to other filters with [[microfine scrubber]]s that could block out unusual trace gases.<ref name="EGWT" />

==History==
[[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] carried several Roamer-6 masks aboard the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] and once used them while exploring a cavern in the [[Hoth asteroid field/Legends|Hoth asteroid field]] following the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]], initially unaware that they were inside the belly of a [[Exogorth/Legends|space slug]].
